ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제3854호 (effective 1987-01-01, 제29조② 장관은 국무위원으로 보하고, 제37조 상공부) in force at the window start. The office existed under the same name before the window (국가기록원 OG0018011, 1948.07.17 ~ 1993.03.05), so the holdover 나웅배 spell (from 1986-08-27) is under the same name. Merged with 동력자원부 into 상공자원부 by 법률 제4541호 (제37조 retitled, 제37조의2 삭제), which took effect with 대통령령 제13870호 on 1993-03-06. No deputy PM title.

정부조직법 법률 제4541호 제37조 and 부칙 제1조 단서, effective 1993-03-06 with 대통령령 제13870호 상공자원부와그소속기관직제. Also took over 동력자원부's functions (energy lineage ends 1993-03-05). Renamed 통상산업부 by 법률 제4831호 (effective 1994-12-23). No deputy PM title.

정부조직법 법률 제4831호 제37조 and 부칙 제1조 단서, effective 1994-12-23 with 대통령령 제14444호. Renamed 산업자원부 by 법률 제5529호 (1998-02-28), which is covered by roster/industry.verified.json. This file covers the window to 1998-02-24. No deputy PM title.

spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (holdover). Named in the 10-ministry 개각 of the morning of 1986-08-26 ('임명발령', 경향신문 1986-08-26) and given the 임명장 with eight other new ministers on the morning of 1986-08-27, followed by his 취임식 the same day. The start is the 임명장 day, as on the motir page, hence start_confidence medium (the announcement day is the alternative). The 제5공화국 cabinet's collective resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and he received the 임명장 as 부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 (epb lineage) the same day, so the spell ends on 1988-02-25 with a same-day handover to 안병화. end_reason other means moved to another cabinet post. Birth date from ko.wikipedia bio https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42476387 (revid 42476387, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T09:04:18-0400, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/wiki/wiki_bio_나웅배.json) and Wikidata Q3565130 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q3565130 (Wikidata SPARQL, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T10:20:50-0400, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/wiki/wikidata_people.json)), and the NA record gives the same date. spells.notes: Named in the 3·17 개각 on the morning of Saturday 1990-03-17 and given the 임명장 on the morning of Monday 1990-03-19, with his 취임식 at 14:00 that day. start_confidence is medium because the announcement day is the alternative. Retained in the 9·19 개각 of 1990 (see continuity). Replaced in the 12·27 개각 of 1990, announced in the morning with the new ministers' 임명장 in the afternoon, so the end is 1990-12-27 with a same-day handover. Birth date left empty. ko.wikipedia bio https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41126237 (revid 41126237, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T10:12:34-0400, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/wiki/wiki_bio_박필수.json) gives '(음력)1938-03-19', a lunar date, while 경향신문 1990-03-17 prints his age as 58 (경향신문 1990-03-17 p.1 '商工<新>朴弼秀(58)' (Naver News Library article 1990031700329201014, OCR text, page image https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990031700329201014&editNo=3&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-03-17&officeId=00032&pageNo=1&printNo=13684&publishType=00020), POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1990031700329201014, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/newslib/nl_1990031700329201014.json (accessed 2026-09-26T13:35:21-0400). Quote: '朴弼秀 (58)'), which does not fit 1938 (see issues). spells.notes: Legal continuation, not a separately reported tenure. 법률 제4831호 took effect on 1994-12-23, the day the Assembly passed it, and the 12·23 개각 followed that afternoon (BigKinds full text: 국민일보 1994-12-24 '부총리 홍재형(재경)·김덕(통일)씨' (news_id 01100201.19941224000000102, GET https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100201.19941224000000102&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000), snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/bigkinds/bk_01100201.19941224000000102.json (accessed 2026-09-26T09:50:16-0400). Quote: '김영삼대통령은 23일 오후 정부직제개편에 따른 전면적인 개각을 단행'). Its 부칙 제2조① deems 상공자원부 officials to be 통상산업부 officials without the 정무직 exclusion written for the merged ministries, so 김철수 held 통상산업부장관 from 1994-12-23 until 박재윤 received the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24. No new appointment was made (reappointed_on_reorg false). He was replaced although his retention had been expected because of his WTO 사무총장 candidacy (동아일보 1994-12-24). No dated 이임식 was found, and the papers of 12-24 already call him 前장관, so the end follows the successor's 임명장 (inferred_from_successor, as on the motir page). See issues for the alternatives (end 1994-12-23, or no 통상산업부 spell). roster/environment.ext88.json treats 박윤흔 (환경처 to 환경부, same clause) the same way. Birth date not found. 국민일보 1993-02-26 gives his age as 52 (BigKinds full text: 국민일보 1993-02-26 '부총리 이경식(경제)·한완상(통일)씨/김 대통령 조각발표' (news_id 01100201.19930226000000101, GET https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100201.19930226000000101&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000), snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/bigkinds/bk_01100201.19930226000000101.json (accessed 2026-09-26T09:31:34-0400). spells.notes: Promoted from 통상산업부 차관 in the 12·20 개각 of 1996 and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Replaced after about two and a half months over the 한보 affair in the 3·5 개각 of 1997, announced on the afternoon of 1997-03-05. No dated 이임식 was found (News Library and BigKinds searches for '안광구 이임', '安光叴' and '이임식' 1997-03-04..10), so the end is the successor's 임명장 day, 1997-03-06 (inferred_from_successor, as on the motir page). ko.wikipedia's list gives 1997-03-05 and its '대한민국 통상산업부' page gives 1997-03-13 (see issues). Birth date not found. Gender M from the profile '부인 金香淑씨와 1남1녀' (매일경제 1996-12-21 p.3 '수출활력에 정책 최우선 安光叴 통산' (Naver News Library article 1996122100099103002, OCR text, page image https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1996122100099103002&editNo=15&printCount=1&publishDate=1996-12-21&officeId=00009&pageNo=3&printNo=9633&publishType=00010), POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1996122100099103002, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/newslib/nl_1996122100099103002.json (accessed 2026-09-26T10:23:37-0400). spells.notes: YS-era holdover. 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28 and turned 통상산업부 into 산업자원부. Contemporary Yonhap reports list 산업자원부 among the seven new ministries whose 장·차관 posts were vacant until the 1998-03-03 cabinet, so no 산업자원부 spell is created for 정해주. The day-level end 1998-02-27 follows offices.json (통상산업부 to 1998-02-27). The ministry page (to 1998-03-03) and Wikipedia (to 1998-03-02) count his tenure up to the new cabinet. Birth date and gender were not found in a saved source. Verifier: 연합뉴스 1997-11-19 spells the given name 鄭海주(삼수변에舟), i.e. 洀, which confirms the hanja 鄭海洀. Namu Wiki's 鄭海週 is wrong. 매일경제 1998-03-04 reports that the old ministers, who had been on standby, held their farewells on 1998-03-03. This is a de facto caretaker period, not a legal tenure in 산업자원부 (the 1998 law excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer).

issues.desc: Start and end convention where the announcement and the 임명장 fall on different days. Pre-2001 there is no gazette file. This file starts each spell on the 임명장 day, which is also the day the motir 역대 장관 page (tier 2) prints for every holder here, and gives start_confidence medium in the split cases (나웅배 1986-08-26 -> 08-27, 박필수 1990-03-17 -> 03-19, 한봉수 1991-12-19 -> 12-20, 박재윤 1994-12-23 -> 12-24, 임창열 1997-03-05 -> 03-06). An outgoing minister ends on the day of a dated 이임식 or 퇴임식 when one was found (한승수 1990-03-17, 이봉서 1991-12-19, 한봉수 1993-02-26, 박재윤 1996-12-20, 임창열 1997-11-19), and otherwise on the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor, 김철수 1994-12-24 and 안광구 1997-03-06). roster/energy.ext88.json uses the same start rule, and roster/culture.ext88.json ends 이민섭 on his 이임식 day (1994-12-23). roster/energy.ext88.json ends 이봉서 on 1990-03-19 for the same 3·17 reshuffle because no dated 이임식 was found for him. If the announcement day were the legal date, 박필수 would start on 1990-03-17 (no vacancy), 한봉수 on 1991-12-19, 박재윤 on 1994-12-23, 임창열 on 1997-03-05 and 나웅배 on 1986-08-26.

One-day vacancy 1990-03-18. 한승수 held his 퇴임식 at 10:00 on 1990-03-17 (동아일보 1990-03-17 p.2) and 박필수 received the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19 (동아일보 1990-03-19, 한국일보 1990-03-20). The acting record for 차관 임인택 is inferred (he was the sitting 차관 per 조선일보 1990-03-18 and 매일경제 1990-03-19). The motir page and ko.wikipedia run 한승수 to 1990-03-19, which would remove the vacancy.

김철수 and the two reorganizations. (1) He was announced on 1993-02-26 as 상공자원부장관, but the office did not exist until 1993-03-06 (법률 제4541호, 대통령령 제13870호), so the legal office for 1993-02-26..03-05 is 상공부장관 and the spell is split at 1993-03-06. 부칙 제2조 of 법률 제4541호 excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer, and no new 임명장 was found around 1993-03-06, so reappointed_on_reorg is null for the 상공자원부 spell (the culture lineage treats 이민섭 the same way). (2) 법률 제4831호 took effect on 1994-12-23 and its 부칙 제2조① carries 상공자원부 officials into 통상산업부 without a 정무직 exclusion, so a 통상산업부 spell 1994-12-23..12-24 is recorded (reorg_continuation true, reappointed_on_reorg false), as roster/environment.ext88.json does for 박윤흔. No story calls him 통상산업부장관, the papers of 12-24 call him 前장관, and no dated 이임식 was found. Alternatives are an end on 1994-12-23 or no 통상산업부 spell with the 상공자원부 spell ending on 1994-12-22 and a one-day vacancy.

Secondary sources that disagree with the day-of reports and were not followed. ko.wikipedia '대한민국 산업통상부 장관' (revid 42290008) ends 박재윤 on 1996-12-19, 안광구 on 1997-03-05 and 임창열 on 1997-11-18. The ko.wikipedia page '대한민국 통상산업부' (revid 40693679) starts 안광구 on 1996-12-19 and gives 1997-03-13 for the 안광구 to 임창열 change, which no other source supports. The motir page prints each end as the successor's start day, so its 한승수 (1990-03-19) and 이봉서 (1991-12-20) ends are not the dates of the outgoing minister's farewell.

Holder list is complete for the window. The motir 역대 장관 page (tier 2, rows 40 to 53), the ko.wikipedia list and the day-of news name the same holders from 1986-08-27 to 1998-02-27 (나웅배, 안병화, 한승수, 박필수, 이봉서, 한봉수, 김철수, 박재윤, 안광구, 임창열, 정해주). For the fourteen reshuffles of 1989-1997 that did not change the minister, continuity.retention_evidence gives a 유임 report dated after the reshuffle or a later report that still names the incumbent as minister. Single-ministry changes elsewhere in the cabinet were not checked one by one. The only gap between consecutive spells is 1990-03-18. The from_main record for 정해주 agrees with the day-of reports found here (동아일보 and 한겨레 1997-11-20, 임명장 on 1997-11-19), so no issue is raised for it.

Person details. 박필수's birth date is left empty because ko.wikipedia gives a lunar date '(음력)1938-03-19' while 경향신문 1990-03-17 prints his age as 58. No birth date was found for 한봉수, 김철수 (age 52 in 국민일보 1993-02-26, born 1941 per the ko.wikipedia disambiguation page) and 안광구. Wikidata Q5646570 (한봉수, 1933-08-25) is a 합기도 master and the Wikidata items labelled 김철수 are other people, so none is used. 안병화's and 박재윤's birth dates rest on ko.wikipedia alone. Gender for every holder is M, from Wikidata P21 or a contemporary profile naming a wife.

Cross-lineage consistency. 나웅배's end (1988-02-25) matches his 부총리 start in roster/epb.ext88.json, 박재윤's start (1994-12-24) follows his 재무부 end (1994-12-22) in roster/finance.ext88.json, 임창열's end (1997-11-19) matches his 재정경제원 start in roster/finance.ext88.json, and 이봉서's 동력자원부 spell (energy) ends on 1990-03-19, nine months before his 상공부 start. roster/finance.ext88.json ends 한승수 (재정경제원) on 1997-03-06 although he held his 이임식 on the afternoon of 1997-03-05 (한겨레 1997-03-06 p.9 '한승수 전부총리 떠나면서 남긴 말 "관리들,정치 괘념말고 경제 챙겨라"' (Naver News Library article 1997030600289109008, OCR text, page image https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1997030600289109008&editNo=6&printCount=1&publishDate=1997-03-06&officeId=00028&pageNo=9&printNo=2820&publishType=00010), POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1997030600289109008, snapshot roster/sources/industry/ext88/newslib/nl_1997030600289109008.json (accessed 2026-09-26T13:36:46-0400). Quote: '한 전 부총리는 5일 오후 과천 정부청사 지하 대회의실에 가진 이임식에서'). That is the same reshuffle in which 안광구 ends here on 1997-03-06, since no 이임식 was found for him.

from_main record 정해주 (통상산업부 1997-11-19..1998-02-27) is copied unchanged. The day-of reports found here confirm the start. No tier 1 to 3 evidence against the end was found. The ko.wikipedia page '대한민국 통상산업부' (revid 40693679, tier 4) ends him on 1998-02-25 and lists 차관 한덕수 as 직무대리 from 1998-02-25 to 1998-03-05, while roster/industry.verified.json cites contemporary reports that the old ministers stayed until the 1998-03-03 cabinet. This is noted for the researcher and not acted on.

Verifier (2026-09-26). No date value was changed. Two ends are disputed and kept (see verification.per_spell and verification.disputes). (1) 한승수 1990-03-17 against 1990-03-19. The 퇴임식 at 10:00 on 17 Mar comes from one report (동아일보 1990-03-17 p.2) and precedes the 11:30 announcement. Seven verified lineages end their 3·17 predecessors on 03-19, while epb keeps 조순 on 03-17.
